source_exact.database: postgres:17-alpine, three independent Go test processes and fresh schemas, 10k/100k owner-scoped Node/Asset/Metadata records

workload: Original GORM Worker-equivalent 100-ID Node FOR UPDATE and PhotoAsset SELECTs, three logical offsets × two repeats × 2 query classes × 2 PostgreSQL statistics phases per scale; no durable Worker executed in EXPLAIN phase
limitations: PostgreSQL ANALYZE is a fixture-only statistics change; EXPLAIN executes SELECT and warms caches. No product index change, throughput, CPU/I/O, real 100k media decode or WAN claims. No absolute Worker A/B speedup.
